telemetry.title: Usage statistics
telemetry.label: Help improve Switch (optional)
telemetry.description: Off by default. When enabled, sends version, operating system, tool identifiers and operation results to FolkBench. Your random installation ID is not a hardware fingerprint.
telemetry.excluded: Never includes API keys, passwords, chats, project paths, custom API addresses or local token/cost totals.
telemetry.disable: Turning this off clears queued events and stops future reports. A request already in progress may finish; sent records follow the server retention policy.
telemetry.error: Unable to read or save this setting. Your previous choice is retained.
